roadmap_payload.problem: A required independent review backend can accept a review request without materializing any reviewer identity or durable review artifact, leaving CDC unable to distinguish submission from actual review and encouraging blind retries or false gate completion.
roadmap_payload.fix: Add a review-backend reconciliation/failover control: treat request acceptance as submission evidence only; require concrete reviewer/review readback bound to the exact source/package/metadata/stage; classify non-materializing backends unavailable/no-op; do not repeat unchanged requests; route to another authorized independent reviewer backend when available or persist an exact blocker/handoff.
roadmap_payload.invariant: Independent SPEC/code-quality stages advance only from a fresh concrete reviewer identity and durable review result for the exact candidate. Empty reviewer surfaces and accepted-but-unmaterialized requests never count as review evidence.
